entities.summary: Noritake Takahara is a former racing driver from Japan. He participated in 2 Formula One World Championship Grands Prix, debuting on 24 October 1976. He scored no championship points. Along with his compatriots Masahiro Hasemi and Kazuyoshi Hoshino, he was the first Japanese driver to start a Formula One Grand Prix. Noritake Takahara was a architects & engineers from Tokyo (b. 1951-06-06, Tokyo). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
